skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Analyze the fundamental elements of public policy, the public policy system, and the role of public policy.
Understand and analyze the process of policy formulation, implementation, monitoring, and evaluation.
Practice skills in group work, communication, presentation, and persuasive speaking.
Demonstrate independent learning, teamwork, and professional responsibility; show social responsibility and ethical conduct; develop self-learning and adaptability.
Practice skills in analyzing and designing specific public policies.
Practice skills in organizing, implementing, monitoring, and evaluating specific public policies.
